_comment: Source of truth for the curated SLO alerting system. Consumed by scripts/gen_grafana_alerts.py -> alerting/grafana/*.json, provisioned by scripts/grafana_provision.py. SEPARATE from the triage-bot escalation_score machinery. Design: references/architecture/alerting-system-design.md; status: ...-status.md. NEVER put Slack webhook URLs or passwords here. v3: round 2 — added SLO-1 (ES, light), SLO-8 + F2 (rabbitmq_queue). SLO-6 dormant; SLO-2/3 gateway -> Datadog (no Grafana plugin).

meta.paging_target: slack-only for now. A Grafana 'XMatters' contact point exists; route P1 there ONLY after this system proves value AND the user authorizes it.
meta.routing_note: Every rule carries notification_settings.receiver=triage-bot-health, delivering DIRECTLY to that contact point and BYPASSING the shared notification-policy tree (default receiver #alert-system). Zero edits to the shared policy.
meta.es_perf_note: ES-datasource alerts query the SHARED ES cluster (382 shards) per eval. SLO-1 is deliberately cheap: tight _index: scope, single-window absolute count, 5-min eval in its own rule group.

slos.verified: Elasticsearch ds(000000003) sees auth index: 3563 docs/3h, 1 Error baseline (2026-06-18). Light: single query, 5m eval, _index-scoped.

rules.name: slo-8-subscriber-down
rules.desc: a live event-consumer queue has 0 consumers — subscriber down; event processing & cache invalidation halt

rules.name: slo-8-consumer-lag
rules.desc: event-consumer queue backlog > 1000 (consumers alive but lagging)

slos.verified: rabbitmq_queue: live consumer queues have consumers 2-4, ready 0 (2026-06-18).
_error queues static (difference=0 baseline); publish_rate is dead, so we use non_negative_difference(messages_ready) per queue. Fires on a +50/5m dead-letter spike, not the existing static backlogs.

slos.reason: viewdesigner_request (and view_request) have NO data in the last 30 days (last point 2026-05-19) — the designer metric pipeline is dormant. Building on it = silent never-fire. Revive when designer metrics resume, or locate the live designer datasource.

Gateway logs (method-gateway-*) are Warning-only ki-21 noise — no status codes, no errors. No InfluxDB/Prometheus gateway measurement. Datadog HAS gateway data (trace.aspnet_core.request.duration{service:ms-gateway-api}) but Grafana has no Datadog datasource plugin (install=server-admin). Path: install the Grafana Enterprise Datadog plugin and build like the others, OR native DD monitors -> DD Slack integration to #triage-bot-health. Note: gateway-down impact already surfaces via SLO-4/5/7.

No gateway latency in any Grafana datasource (gateway logs lack ElapsedMilliseconds; no gateway metric). Datadog HAS it (trace.aspnet_core.request.duration{service:ms-gateway-api}). Same path as SLO-2: Grafana Datadog plugin (server-admin) or native DD monitors.

ownership_gaps: runtime-core is one deployable split across 3 teams by host (runtime-core-api->Vertical App Experience, runtime-core-subscriber-api->CRM Experience, designer-core-api->No Code Next Gen).
DevOps team has no TeamSlackAlertChannel webhook in the ownership grid.
Components/projects mapped to teams not in the Teams grid: Impact, Stock Apps, Internal, Logstash, blank/Department.
Vertical App Experience and Transactions share one webhook (B063S8NBW0M).
